title: Rethinking Pre-Training and Augmentation for Zero-Shot Cross-City Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.24154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world deployment of traffic surveillance systems is bottlenecked by geographic domain shift, in which models trained in one city underperform when applied to an unseen target city. Conventional domain adaptation relies on hyperparameter-sensitive architectures or direct profiling of target data. Both are fundamentally precluded in privacy-conscious ecosystems that require completely blind training and evaluation loops. In this setting, we explore the effects of pre-training and augmentation in addressing the domain shift problem. Specifically, we propose a new modular training pipeline for object detection structured around two core orthogonal pillars: (1) a multi-dataset pre-training strategy featuring a class-agnostic objectness distillation to decouple structural vehicle geometry from semantic taxonomies, and (2) a domain-resilient augmentation stream featuring a novel Grayworld transformation that forces global attention heads

translated_title: 重新思考零样本跨城市目标检测的预训练与增强方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24154v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：交通监控系统的实际部署受到地理域偏移的瓶颈限制，即在一个城市训练的模型应用于未见的另一个城市时性能下降。传统的域适应方法依赖于超参数敏感的架构或直接分析目标数据，这两者在需要完全盲训练和评估循环的隐私敏感生态系统中根本不可行。在此背景下，我们探索了预训练和增强在解决域偏移问题中的作用。具体而言，我们提出了一种新的模块化目标检测训练流程，围绕两个核心正交支柱构建：（1）一种多数据集预训练策略，采用类无关的物体性蒸馏，将结构性的车辆几何与语义分类解耦；（2）一种域鲁棒性增强流，包含新颖的Grayworld变换，迫使全局注意力头发挥作用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多数据集预训练和域鲁棒增强的模块化训练流程，通过类无关物体性蒸馏和Grayworld变换，实现无需访问目标数据的零样本跨城市目标检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular training pipeline combining multi-dataset pre-training and domain-resilient augmentation, using class-agnostic objectness distillation and Grayworld transformation to achieve zero-shot cross-city object detection without accessing target data.
